=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5161-5209 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: create_judge_fixup_issues_from_verdict consumes untrusted judge `new_issues[]` entries without validating non-empty, non-null `FIX_TITLE` and `FIX_ID` before creating and recording GitHub issues.
  WHY: Malformed entries can create junk or untracked issues, or cause `gh issue create` to abort the recovery cycle before state persistence and notifications; severity was reported as MAJOR and BLOCKER, so BLOCKER is used.
- prompts/_templates/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt:55-71 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The include-based template lacks the six lines of judge guidance appended to prompts/mode-orchestrate-poll-judge.txt:66-71.
  WHY: test_assembled_templates_match_legacy_prompt_bytes fails because the assembled template does not match the legacy prompt, and template-mode rendering omits the new guidance.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18889-18896 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `issue_number_map` state writes performed inside the pipeline-fed `while read` loop do not persist because the loop runs in a subshell.
  WHY: The exhausted-arm comment reports no fix-up references and the newly created issues are not tracked by the poller.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5194-5209 | severity=blocker | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `issue_number_map` writes from the in-budget fix-up creation loop are lost because the pipeline-fed `while read` loop runs in a subshell.
  WHY: Subsequent cycles see stale deduplication state and can create duplicate GitHub issues for the same fix-up id.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3852-3863 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `CWS_BACKPRESSURE_AHEAD_BY` does not handle an empty `CWS_WORK_AHEAD_BY` value when it is assigned from `INTEGRATION_AHEAD_BY_WORK_COMMITS`.
  WHY: An empty work-ahead value can incorrectly fall back to `CWS_AHEAD_BY`, allowing sync merges to count toward backpressure.
- agents.md: "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The new `RECOVERY_BUDGET_ACCOUNTING` structured log prefix is emitted but is not registered in the contractual stable-log-prefix list.
  WHY: Downstream tooling and future drift checks cannot rely on the registry to detect a rename or removal of the prefix.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
